selected.title: HSBC to make 'deep, wide and brutal' UK wealth management job cuts in AI push
selected.summary: HSBC is planning to axe up to 70% of its UK financial advisors as part of swingeing cuts to its wealth management business driven by riding use of AI, according to the Financial Times.
selected.why: HSBC plans to cut up to 70% of UK financial advisors in AI-driven restructuring.

reason: HSBC's AI-driven cuts to wealth advisors raise arguable questions about whether automation destroys genuine financial advice value or merely eliminates redundant intermediation.
angle: Cutting 70% of wealth advisors via AI proves financial advice is largely commodity matching, not bespoke expertise requiring human judgment.
